description.tr: Mikrogram hassasiyetinde hidrostatik terazi inşa eden, 50 maddenin özgül ağırlığını ölçen ve yerçekiminin Dünya merkezine uzaklıkla değiştiğini öneren eski bir Bizans kölesi — Newton'dan 500 yıl önce || Hâzinî, Malazgirt (1071) sonrası esir alınan bir Bizans Rum'uydu. Kitâbü Mîzâni'l-Hikme 'ortaçağın her kültür alanından en kapsamlı tartı eseri' olarak tanımlanır. || [Tarih notu] Khanikoff'un 1859 kısmi çevirisi Hâzinî'yi Batı bilim tarihine tanıttı.
description.en: A former Byzantine slave who built a hydrostatic balance precise to the microgram, measured specific gravities of 50 substances, and proposed that gravity varies with distance from Earth's center — 500 years before Newton || Al-Khazini was a Byzantine Greek captured after Manzikert (1071), educated by his master, and studied under Khayyam himself. His Book of the Balance of Wisdom is described as 'the most comprehensive work on weighing in the Middle Ages, from any cultural area.' He proposed gravity varies with distance from Earth's center — not systematically explored again until Newton. He lived in extreme asceticism, refusing 1,000 dinars and living on 3 dinars per year. || [Historiographical note] Khanikoff's 1859 partial translation first introduced Khazini to Western science history. Ibel (1908) and Hall (1981) confirmed the unprecedented precision of his measurements.
description.ar: عبد بيزنطي سابق بنى ميزانًا هيدروستاتيكيًا بدقة الميكروغرام || الخازني بيزنطي أُسر بعد ملاذكرد. كتاب ميزان الحكمة 'أشمل عمل عن الموازين في العصور الوسطى.' اقترح تغيّر الجاذبية بالمسافة — قبل نيوتن بخمسة قرون
